en: I demolished the old wall yesterday.
I did not demolish my house.
You demolished the shack on the farm.
You did not demolish the big garage.
You (f.) demolished the whole old wall.
You (f.) did not demolish the small room.
The builder demolished the old kitchen.
He did not demolish the neighbor's wall.
The company demolished the old house.
She did not demolish the big gate.
We demolished the first shack in the morning.
We did not demolish the neighbors' building.
You (pl.) demolished all the broken stairs.
You (pl.) did not demolish our wall.
The workers demolished the old building.
They did not demolish the old school.
I demolish the wall to widen the room.
I do not demolish old houses.

lat: nta dima katheddem kulshi b zerba
en: You always demolish everything quickly.
You do not demolish the building by force.
You (f.) are demolishing the kitchen wall now.
You (f.) do not demolish your garage.
He demolishes shacks every day.
He does not demolish the wall with a hammer.
She demolishes the dangerous building.
The machine does not demolish the strong wall.

lat: kanheddmu d-dar bash nebniw we7da jdida
ar: كنهدمو الدار باش نبنيو وحدة جديدة
en: We demolish the house to build a new one.
We do not demolish old places.
You (pl.) are demolishing the large room today.
You (pl.) do not demolish your kitchen.
The workers are demolishing the old wall now.
They do not demolish the new houses.

lat: ghadi nheddem had l-7ayt ghedda f s-sba7
ar: غادي نهدم هاد الحيط غدا فالصباح
en: I am going to demolish this wall tomorrow morning.

lat: ma ghadish nheddem l-bab dyal d-dar
ar: ما غاديش نهدم الباب ديال الدار
en: I am not going to demolish the door of the house.

lat: nta ghadi theddem l-kuzina l-simana l-jaya
ar: نتا غادي تهدم الكوزينة السيمانة الجاية
en: You are going to demolish the kitchen next week.

lat: ma ghadish theddem l-garaj dyalek daba
ar: ما غاديش تهدم الكراج ديالك دابا
en: You are not going to demolish your garage now.

lat: nti ghadi theddmi l-bit s-sghir ghedda
ar: نتي غادي تهدمي البيت الصغير غدا
en: You (f.) are going to demolish the small room tomorrow.
You (f.) are not going to demolish the whole house.
He is going to demolish the shack tonight.

lat: huwa ma ghadish yheddem had s-sur
ar: هو ما غاديش يهدم هاد السور
en: He is not going to demolish this outer wall.
The municipality is going to demolish the old building.

lat: hiya ma ghadish theddem d-dar dyalha
ar: هي ما غاديش تهدم الدار ديالها
en: She is not going to demolish her house.

ar: حنا غادي نهدمو الكراج ديال الفرمة
en: We are going to demolish the farm's garage.

lat: ma ghadish nheddmu had l-7ayt l-yum
ar: ما غاديش نهدمو هاد الحيط اليوم
en: We are not going to demolish this wall today.
You (pl.) are going to demolish all the shacks.

lat: ntuma ma ghadish theddmu s-sur l-kbir
ar: نتوما ما غاديش تهدمو السور الكبير
en: You (pl.) are not going to demolish the big wall.
The workers are going to demolish the building tomorrow.

lat: huma ma ghadish yheddmu l-7ayt dyal l-medrasa
ar: هما ما غاديش يهدمو الحيط ديال المدرسة
en: They are not going to demolish the school wall.
